intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in {{cityA}}. This page compares recorded fees and placements from our database opened in {{year}}.

GLS Institute of Business Administration vs Rai University is a same-city private comparison. Rai has the higher recorded year tuition and the higher recorded packages, from 2022. GLS has a 2023 year, so the placement years are not the same.

sections.heading: GLS Institute of Business Administration vs Rai University for BBA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose GLS Institute of Business Administration if a lower recorded year tuition matters most. Our records list ₹26,500 a year, with 2023 figures of a ₹3 lakh average and a ₹4 lakh highest package.
Choose Rai University if you want the higher recorded packages, from 2022, at an average of ₹5 lakh and a highest of ₹7 lakh, and can budget recorded tuition of ₹70,000 a year.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: GLS Institute of Business Administration has recorded BBA tuition of ₹26,500 a year. Treat this as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed three-year total, until you check the institute's official circular.
Rai University has recorded tuition of ₹70,000 a year. That is higher than GLS in our records. Confirm both official notices for the current admission year.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: GLS has recorded 2023 figures of an average package of ₹3 lakh and a highest package of ₹4 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.
Rai University's latest recorded year here is 2022, with an average of ₹5 lakh and a highest of ₹7 lakh. The years are not the same, so do not read them as a same-batch comparison.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Neither side has an entrance exam listed in our records on this page. Many Ahmedabad BBA admissions are based on Class 12 marks, sometimes with a university test or interview.
Read the current official admissions page of each institute for eligibility and any entrance requirement.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. GLS Institute of Business Administration is part of the GLS campus in the city. Rai University is a separate private university campus.
If you already plan to stay in Ahmedabad, visit both campuses and compare the official fee, not just the brand name.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If recorded year tuition is your first filter, GLS is lower in our records, at ₹26,500 against Rai's ₹70,000.
If you want the higher recorded packages, Rai's 2022 figures are higher than GLS's 2023 figures, but the years are different.
Confirm both official fee circulars and the latest placement reports before you decide.
